summary: @buckgold1 I used to allow choice, but it got hard to support, then went to WordPress.com. Many students wanted "safety" of LMS so last semester I let them choose the Blackboard "blogs" or their own domain.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @buckgold1 I used to allow choice, but it got hard to support, then went to WordPress.com. Many students wanted "safety" of LMS so last semester I let them choose the Blackboard "blogs" or their own domain.
